description: A React component that displays a panel of recent logs, allowing users to preview, download, and refresh log data. It interacts with APIs for fetching logs and managing their display.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Asynchronously downloads a log file by its ID and saves it as a text file.

methods.name: openPreview
methods.description: Handles fetching a log for preview, falling back to download if inline fetch fails.
